name: Shell Config
description: Adds a line to shell profile/rc files to source local shell config files. Assumes you have one or more shell configuration scripts in your .devcontainer workspace that you wish to source from shell config.

localConfigFiles.description: Colon (:) separated paths to your local config files. Eg: ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/mysetup.sh

shellRcFiles.description: Colon (:) separated list of shell rc files. Each localConfigFiles will be sourced in each shellRcFiles.

idempotent.description: Skip adding source line if already present in rc file
